findings.reason: the plan's claim that no finder exists in ambix is false, and topology-source is still open, so the decision should cite the in-repo finders before choosing nova.
findings.text: §2 states X-points and strike points come from the EQDB record or nova "rather than by a new finder in ambix", but ambix already carries topology finders the census missed: equilibrium_labels.xpoint_null_set (ima_ambix/worldmodel/equilibrium_labels.py:264) and camera_topology_targets._strike_points (imas_ambix/worldmodel/camera_topology_targets.py:258), plus the axis/boundary extractor at imas_ambix/challenge/convention.py:226; the open decision topology-source must account for them (extend, retire, or state they are MAST-surrogate-scoped)

findings.reason: naming the module and its interface is exactly the deep-module decision the plan leaves unstated, and it is cheaper to fix before the first implementation node.
findings.text: the section names a CLI entry point and says the writer "extends the two owners", but names no module that owns the join of description arrays, signal-map samples and the netCDF write, so the substantial behaviour (which field gets which time base, homogeneous_time, the write layout) has no hiding place and will accrete as CLI-body glue

findings.reason: an unjustified second JT-60SA imas-ink driver drifts from the first and doubles the surface a rendering change must touch; the plan should extend figures_jt60sa_geometry.py or say in §4 why it cannot.
findings.text: the section adds scripts/jt60sa_pulse_animation.py as a new script that opens IDSs, builds geometry with extract_geometry and calls animate_pulse, which is what scripts/figures_jt60sa_geometry.py:144 main already does (it imports NetCDFTransformEngine and imas_ink.extract.extract_geometry), and several scripts already drive equilibrium_figure_mpl (scripts/patch_flux_map_report.py:311, scripts/topology_engine_overlays.py:154, scripts/connectivity_boundary_gate_eval.py:699); the plan neither extends the existing script nor justifies a parallel one

findings.reason: the mint should extend the existing netCDF writer and reuse machine_description_bytes for the byte-for-byte assertion rather than fork both.
findings.text: the plan's mint writes one netCDF IDS per file through imas.DBEntry, a path already owned in the tree by store_arms.write_imas_netcdf (imas_ambix/bench/store_arms.py:193, "Write an IDS through the public imas.DBEntry netCDF path") and repeated at imas_ambix/challenge/thomson_ids.py:157 and imas_ambix/data/selene_deck.py:1278 (the store's own writer), plus imas_ambix/gs/geometry_export.py:425 write_geometry_fields; the plan adds a fourth without naming any as the owner, and its "static geometry equals the OP1 description byte for byte" check ignores the existing serialiser imas_ambix/data/description_identity.py:67 machine_description_bytes

findings.reason: with cli_options at 0 the section must, in its own text, name what the new command retires or merges or why nothing can be, before the first node adds the surface.
findings.text: the section adds a `mint` subcommand to imas_ambix/data/cli.py (a cli_options entry) into a week whose cli_options budget is 0, and its text names no existing command it retires or merges and states no reason none can be; §4 similarly adds a new public script entry point without an interface account

rubric_items.deep_module: a finding — §1 names a CLI command and two owners but no module that holds the join, so the load→write behaviour is spread over StoreEngine + VirtualZarrView + an unnamed new writer rather than hidden behind one interface.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan's netCDF IDS writer duplicates imas_ambix/bench/store_arms.py:193 write_imas_netcdf (and the store's own writer in selene_deck.py) without naming either as the owner to extend.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §1 adds a `mint` CLI command without naming what it retires or merges, or why nothing can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §1 cites the two owners it extends (StoreEngine, the compiled signal map) and §2 defers topology to nova, but the plan nowhere searched ambix for the IDS→netCDF writers, the description-identity serialiser, or the existing ambix topology finders that already do part of what §1/§2 add.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: a finding — §4 adds scripts/jt60sa_pulse_animation.py, a driver over imas_ink.extract.extract_geometry + animate_pulse that substantially repeats scripts/figures_jt60sa_geometry.py, without saying why that script cannot be extended.
